messages:
maria: Kicking off compatibility + quant smoke for customer Omega's LoRA merge. Plan: merge LoRA -> base, run q4_0 and q4_k_m, tokenizer sanity, then quick-eval pack (100 samples). I’ll post logs. @ken @sasha watch for kv-cache/tokenizer mismatches.

ken: Got it. Checkpoint: s3://customer-omega/lora/v2. Base: open-model-x-13b. I'll try both quant variants. ETA ~30m.

sasha: Heads up — their finetune changed BOS mapping. I pushed a small tokenizer patch in branch omega/tokenizer-fixes.

ajay: Quick merge script I'm using:

```bash
python tools/merge_lora.py \n  --base models/open-model-x-13b \n  --lora s3://customer-omega/lora/v2 \n  --out /tmp/omega_merged
```

ken: Merge succeeded locally. Before quant: 24.3GB. After q4_0 conversion: 23.1GB. After q4_k_m: 22.9GB. Command I ran:

```bash
python tools/quantize.py --in /tmp/omega_merged --out /tmp/omega_q4k --mode q4_k_m
```

eval-bot: Quick-eval pack started (100 prompts). Metrics tracked: instr-score / exact-match / rouge-l. Partial results after 30 prompts:
- base (fp16): instr-score 87.4
- merged q4_0: instr-score 86.5 (delta -0.9)
- merged q4_k_m: instr-score 84.9 (delta -2.5)

maria: -0.9% on q4_0 is borderline but maybe acceptable. Can you post per-category breakdown (long-context vs short, code vs convo)?

eval-bot: Uploaded breakdown: s3://redwood-evals/omega/quickpack/1781234567/results.csv

sasha: Found 2 repros of kv-cache mismatch on q4_k_m with long-history (>2048). Pasted excerpt:

[2026-03-21T02:12:03Z] ERROR runtime: kv-cache length mismatch (expected 2049, got 0)
stack: runtime/kvcache.go:142 -> runtime/decoder.go:78
input: user conversation length 2100 tokens

ken: Repro'd with the same prompt. Stacktrace points to position_ids handling when past seq > 2048. Could be tokenizer padding differences. I'll run tokenizer sanity and replay.

ajay: Ran tokenizer diff between base and finetune tokenizer: small mapping diff — BOS changed 1 -> 3, and special token order shuffled. Patch applied to tokenizer config in /deploy/tokenizers/omega.json.

maria: Ok re-run q4_0 only (no k_m) after tokenizer patch. If instr-score delta stays within -1.0%, we can promote to canary.

sasha: Ack. Scheduling canary for q4_0 at 22:00 PT. Tagging @ops-bot for deploy window.

ops-bot: Canary window request received. Scheduled: 2026-03-21T22:00:00-07:00. Approvals: eng-lead required.

maria: Thanks everyone — will post final numbers after the q4_0 re-run. If anyone sees regressions in the short/code category ping here and attach examples. :thumbsup:
